title: Noise in an upstairs room
passage:
Would moving the lesson upstairs solve the noise problem?
A. The upstairs room can be booked online.
B. It's a ten-minute walk to the next building.
C. It depends which way the upstairs windows face.
passageZh:
把課移到樓上能解決噪音問題嗎？
A. 樓上的房間可以上網預約。
B. 走到隔壁那棟要十分鐘。
C. 這要看樓上的窗戶朝哪個方向。
